usage: The word 窗簾 (coeng1 lim4) is used as a noun to refer to curtains.
It is commonly used to describe the fabric hanging in front of windows to block light or provide privacy.
You can use 窗簾 with verbs like 'open' or 'close' to talk about manipulating the curtains.
In conversation, 窗簾 can be paired with adjectives to describe its color, style, or condition.
When describing your home, mentioning 窗簾 helps give a clearer picture of the room's appearance.
